item.title: Where Summer Becomes an Experience: Exceptional Camps Across Europe
item.description: Summer is just around the corner, bringing longer days and the perfect opportunity to consider how your child can make the most of their holiday break. Across Europe, summer camps offer far more than simple entertainment. They create space for children to build confidence, develop new skills, and form friendships that often last well beyond the summer months.
